# Huawei Cloud
> Huawei Cloud provides cloud infrastructure, AI, databases, security, and enterprise platform services with global documentation and APIs.

This site includes product documentation, API references, developer guides, SDK resources, best practices, and support content for Huawei Cloud services.

## Documentation Home
- [Documentation Center](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/): Main entry point for Huawei Cloud product documentation and guides.
- [Developer Guide Center](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/devg-apis.html): Central index for developer guides and API-related resources.
- [API Center](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/apicenter-all.html): Aggregated API reference entry for Huawei Cloud services.
- [Best Practices](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/bestpractice-list.html): Collection of implementation recommendations for common cloud scenarios.
- [FAQs](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/faq.html): Frequently asked questions across Huawei Cloud products and operations.
- [Troubleshooting](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/trouble-index.html): Troubleshooting resources for diagnosing and resolving service issues.

## Getting Started
- [Getting Started](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/getting-started.html): Introductory guides for creating, configuring, and using Huawei Cloud services.
- [User Guide Center](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/usermanual.html): Central access point for product user guides and operational instructions.
- [Quick Start](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/qs.html): Quick-start documentation for deploying and testing services rapidly.
- [Console Help](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/consolehelp.html): Guidance for navigating and using the Huawei Cloud management console.
- [Service Overview](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/productdesc.html): Overview pages describing service capabilities and common use cases.

## API and Developer Resources
- [API Explorer](https://apiexplorer.developer.huaweicloud.com/apiexplorer/overview): Interactive tool for browsing and testing Huawei Cloud APIs.
- [OpenAPI Explorer](https://apiexplorer.developer.huaweicloud.com/apiexplorer/doc?product=ALL&api=ALL): API documentation interface for exploring service operations and parameters.
- [SDK Center](https://developer.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/sdk): Entry point for Huawei Cloud SDK downloads and language support.
- [Developer Center](https://developer.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/): Main developer portal for tools, SDKs, APIs, and integration resources.
- [API Gateway Documentation](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/api-apig/): Reference and guides for publishing and managing APIs.
- [Identity and Access Management API](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/api-iam/): API reference for authentication, authorization, and identity management.

## Compute
- [Elastic Cloud Server Documentation](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/ecs/): Documentation for provisioning and managing virtual machine instances.
- [Elastic Cloud Server API Reference](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/api-ecs/): API operations for creating and administering ECS instances.
- [Auto Scaling Documentation](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/as/): Guides for scaling compute resources automatically.
- [FunctionGraph Documentation](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/functiongraph/): Serverless function service documentation and developer guidance.
- [Cloud Container Engine Documentation](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/cce/): Kubernetes-based container orchestration service documentation.
- [Bare Metal Server Documentation](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/bms/): Guides for dedicated physical server provisioning and management.

## Storage and Database
- [Object Storage Service Documentation](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/obs/): Documentation for scalable object storage and data management.
- [Elastic Volume Service Documentation](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/evs/): Guides for block storage provisioning and lifecycle management.
- [Scalable File Service Documentation](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/sfs/): Documentation for shared file storage services.
- [Relational Database Service Documentation](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/rds/): Guides for managed relational database deployment and operations.
- [GaussDB Documentation](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/gaussdb/): Documentation for Huawei Cloud GaussDB database services.
- [Document Database Service Documentation](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/dds/): Guides for managed document database clusters.

## Networking and CDN
- [Virtual Private Cloud Documentation](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/vpc/): Documentation for isolated virtual networks and routing configuration.
- [Elastic Load Balance Documentation](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/elb/): Guides for distributing traffic across backend resources.
- [Domain Name Service Documentation](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/dns/): Documentation for domain resolution and DNS management.
- [Content Delivery Network Documentation](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/cdn/): Guides for accelerating content delivery globally.
- [Direct Connect Documentation](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/dc/): Documentation for dedicated network connectivity to Huawei Cloud.
- [NAT Gateway Documentation](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/natgateway/): Guides for outbound and inbound network address translation.

## Security and Management
- [Cloud Firewall Documentation](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/cfw/): Documentation for network traffic control and security policies.
- [Web Application Firewall Documentation](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/waf/): Guides for protecting web applications from common attacks.
- [Data Encryption Workshop Documentation](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/dew/): Documentation for key management and cryptographic services.
- [Cloud Trace Service Documentation](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/cts/): Guides for auditing operations and tracking cloud activities.
- [Cloud Eye Documentation](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/ces/): Monitoring and alerting documentation for cloud resources.
- [Resource Formation Service Documentation](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/rfs/): Infrastructure-as-code service documentation for resource orchestration.

## AI and Big Data
- [ModelArts Documentation](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/modelarts/): Documentation for AI development, training, and deployment workflows.
- [Data Lake Insight Documentation](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/dli/): Guides for serverless big data analytics and SQL processing.
- [MapReduce Service Documentation](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/mrs/): Documentation for managed Hadoop and big data clusters.
- [Cloud Search Service Documentation](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/css/): Guides for managed search and analytics clusters.
- [DataArts Studio Documentation](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/dataartsstudio/): Documentation for data integration, governance, and development.
- [Image Recognition Documentation](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/image/): Guides for computer vision and image analysis APIs.

## Migration and DevOps
- [Cloud Container Engine Best Practices](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/bestpractice-cce/): Recommended practices for operating Kubernetes workloads on Huawei Cloud.
- [CodeArts Documentation](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/codearts/): Documentation for DevOps pipelines, repositories, and software delivery.
- [Application Operations Management Documentation](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/aom/): Guides for observability and application operations management.
- [Server Migration Service Documentation](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/sms/): Documentation for migrating servers into Huawei Cloud.
- [Data Replication Service Documentation](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/drs/): Guides for database migration and continuous replication.
- [Cloud Backup and Recovery Documentation](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/cbr/): Documentation for backup, restore, and disaster recovery workflows.

## Support and Community
- [Support Center](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/): Official support portal for documentation and service help.
- [Developer Forum](https://developer.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/forum): Community discussions for Huawei Cloud developers and users.
- [Huawei Cloud Blog](https://developer.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/blog): Articles, announcements, and technical insights from Huawei Cloud.
- [Learning Center](https://developer.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/learning): Training and educational resources for Huawei Cloud technologies.
- [SDK Documentation](https://developer.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/sdk?all): Language SDK resources for integrating Huawei Cloud services.
- [API Explorer Help](https://apiexplorer.developer.huaweicloud.com/apiexplorer/help): Help documentation for using the API Explorer tools.
